text:
maria: Heads-up: launching GPU policy cutover tonight 22:00 UTC for the orbit pools. Change set adjusts autoscale thresholds (min:2->4) and increases burst cap by ~30%. I'll own the cutover. Rollback window is 22:00-22:20 UTC. @ryan @olivia can you be on standby for smoke checks?
ryan: On standby. I'll watch latency SLOs, traces, and open the per-pool dashboards. Ping me if you need a quick trace link.
olivia: I can run the smoke checklist. Quick checklist I'm planning: 1) hit /v1/generate on canary model 2) validate pool-util dashboard + instance counts 3) confirm no evictions >1/min and KV cache hit-rate >90%. Posting commands below.
olivia: ```# smoke commands
# hit canary endpoint
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"orbit-canary","prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .
# dashboard quick grep
kubectl get pods -n orbit-pool -o wide
# check evictions
kubectl logs -n orbit-pool --selector=app=allocator | tail -n 200 | grep -i eviction || true
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled: policy-cutover/orbit at 2026-04-17T22:00:00Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m holds. Will post rollout events.
kyle: Rollback plan: revert the config map to previous commit and reapply. Example helm patch to revert autoscale block: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: orbit-autoscale-config
data:
  policy.yaml: |-
    minReplicas: 2
    burstCapPercent: 0
EOF
``` Keep the previous commit SHA handy: `git rev-parse --short origin/main^{commit}`.
jen: I'll run a lightweight load test during the smoke (5 qps across canary) and post token-cost delta + p95s. If anything looks off, I'll flag immediately.
eng-oncall: Pager on. I'll monitor alerts and CPU/GPU OOMs. If alerting triggers, tag `#incidents` and escalate.
ryan: One note: enable `kv-cache` warmup for the canary to avoid cold-start p95 spikes. Confirm config flag `enable_kv_warmup: true`.
maria: Good catch. Olivia, can you run the warmup at 21:55 so the canary is warmed before the 22:00 start?
olivia: Running warmup now (21:55). Will post results in a minute.
olivia: Warmup done — canary mem stable, p95 latency ~120ms, no evictions in the last 10m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout plan executed: 5% -> 25% at 22:05 -> 50% at 22:10 -> 100% at 22:15 per schedule. Will post each step.
kyle: Abort conditions: >10% error rate OR p95 > 500ms sustained for >2m during ramp => abort + rollback.
maria: Copy. I'll trigger rollback if abort conditions met and will post a short reason and commit SHA. Go/no-go update @ 21:58.
ryan: :thumbsup:
